classes.name: RLightning
classes.comment: Lightning bolt renderer singleton. Size 0x700 from Init 8b930 (operator new 0x700, pointer to global 0x200f4c). Base USingleton (vptr only: ~RLightning 9fec0 restores USingleton vtable 0x18beb0 last). Vptr at +0 on both builds; Xbox +4 from +0x14 to +0x4c (MSVC vector 16 vs GCC 12), 0 from the 16-aligned random tables at +0x50 up to material +0x660, then -0x30 (PS2 +0x6f0 = Xbox +0x6c0) with one packed bool.

notes: RLightning and RLightManager both derive from USingleton (vtable 0x18beb0, vptr only), as their destructors restore it last; USingleton is added as a 4-byte placeholder.

RLightning PS2 layout: vptr +0, GCC vector +0x4..+0x10, then Xbox = PS2+4 to the settings block end (Xbox +0x48); random tables +0x50/+0x450/+0x550/+0x650 and material +0x660 identical; after the material PS2 is +0x30 higher (PS2 +0x6f0 = Xbox +0x6c0). PS2 RenderBolts touches +0x670/+0x690 (8-byte), inside the Xbox material range: either the PS2 UVolatileMaterial is larger (0x90) or those are PS2-only fields.

RLightManager: the evidence shows PS2 AddSpecularLight writing 16 bytes at +0x0, but the PS2 ctor stores the vtable at +0x0; treated as an aliasing artefact. RLightInfo (0x70) is an invented name for the struct returned by PS2 WorldLightInfo/CharacterLightInfo/LightInfo; its +0x30/+0x40/+0x50/+0x60 hold the Light 1/Light 2/Ambient Ground/Ambient Sky colours. Xbox +0x254..+0x29b and +0x3c0..+0x3ef are untouched in the scanned code.
RLightManager highLevelManager at +0x2d8 is typed byte[212] from the gap to the next zeroed dword; its real type and size are unconfirmed (ctor zeroes +0x358 inside it).

SWeaponManager weapon records: 32 x 0x54 bytes (vec_new 0xa80), defaults at 0x1c94d8; Reset also rescales one field every 0x54 bytes of a global table at 0x1c9514 from 0x1c8fd0 * global 0x234e2c. SWeaponManager +0x17c unused (padding to 0x180 or an untouched field).
No misnamed functions seen. Xbox Kill 9ff60/7e930 are statics (typed __stdcall) that delete the global instance.
